properties.name: The design saves itself automatically to wherever its owner chooses
properties.source: Anthony and Alex, 2026-09-25 (relayed in the dev_reflow2 hub session)
properties.statement: The design's export is written automatically, on every change, to a destination the owner chooses — a design repository they can commit (the work case), a folder, a backup location, or the code repository itself for projects where that is welcome. Choosing where is the owner's; remembering to save is nobody's. From a discussion between Anthony and Alex, 2026-09-25: "For work, it still needs to be something I can git commit though or at least something I can save somewhere that I choose ... this becomes optional where and how you want to export your design."
